findings.title: No UI anywhere releases an assessment to students
findings.evidence: POST /api/teacher/assessments/[assessmentId]/release works (no-op POST of an already-released CAT returns 200) but a repo-wide search finds no caller. New assessments from /teacher/assignments set no releasedAt, so they are invisible to students by default. /teacher/planner renders Not released / Hidden from students rows with no action column, while /teacher states Nothing is released to students until you make it. Fixed 2026-09-18: `components/assessment-release-control.tsx` is now rendered in the planner's Release cell and the dashboard's State cell, so the read-only pill is the write path. Verified on the running app: POST to the release route returned 200 and wrote an `assessment.released` audit row, and the planner row changed from Not released / Hidden from students to Released / Visible to students since 17 Sept 2026, 21:09. Once released the control offers no action, because the API has no unrelease route.

findings.title: Marking progress renders an impossible ratio (9 / 0) beside a contradictory Submitted cell
findings.evidence: GET /teacher as dsa.teacher: DSA Section A CAT 1 shows Marked 9 / 0 with a 100% bar, and 0 / 9 for Submitted. Root cause confirmed in SQL: Submission rows = 0 while Grade rows = 9, because graded is not a subset of submitted. The planner repeats it in words: Week 2 practice set 0 submitted, 4 graded. Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the re-seeded database: still reproduces. Fixed 2026-09-18: the Marked bar now counts marks against the cohort, not against submissions, because a manual mark with no Submission row is legitimate product behaviour and graded is not a subset of submitted. `lib/teacher-dashboard-view.ts` gains `markingProgress` and the cell uses it. Verified on the running app: GET /teacher as dsa.teacher renders DSA Section A CAT 1 Marked `9 / 9` and Submitted `0 / 9` (was `9 / 0` beside a 100% bar), and no `N / 0` ratio remains anywhere on the page.

findings.title: Cohort average and every per-assessment Mean ignore Grade rows, so the page contradicts itself
findings.evidence: GET /teacher (dsa) renders Cohort average with No released marks yet and Mean on all four rows, then in the same view Cohort trend with 18 released marks. The analytics payload proves the marks exist: assessments[].average is null and attemptCount 0, while trend.markedCount is 18 and atRisk.publishedCount is 9. Dataset-dependent: demo has quiz attempts so its tile reads 58%, the manual-marked M.Tech sets look dead. Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the re-seeded database: still reproduces.

findings.title: Classes roster counts enrolments, not students: 48 rows for 24 people, duplicates indistinguishable
findings.evidence: /teacher/classes (dsa) header tile reads Enrolled 48 / Active enrolments and the table has 48 rows for 24 distinct students (SQL: 50 enrolments, 25 students). 23BDA0001 appears twice with different averages and no offering column. Demo repeats it across its two offerings. Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the re-seeded database: still reproduces.

findings.title: Publish results is irreversible and fires with no confirmation
findings.evidence: components/teacher-classes-manager.tsx posts to /api/teacher/offerings/[id]/results directly from onClick with no confirm or dialog anywhere in the file. The page copy itself says publishing cannot be undone and starts the retention clock, so one misclick purges a cohort after 15 days. Fixed 2026-09-18: publishing is one-way (`publishOfferingResults` stamps resultsPublishedAt exactly once and there is no route that clears it), so the button now opens a confirmation dialog that names the 15-day retention clock and states there is no unpublish action, matching the assessment release control. The copy and state live in `lib/results-publication-view.ts` and are unit-tested in `tests/results-publication-view.test.ts`.

findings.title: Analytics promises trends and at-risk students and renders neither; the payload is computed and discarded
findings.evidence: The nav and page description say Grade distribution, question quality, trends, and at-risk students. GET /teacher/analytics (demo) renders no at-risk content and no trend chart, yet the RSC payload contains the full roster (atRisk: 2 students) and the 15-week series. The dashboard At risk 2 tile is therefore a dead end, and the roster and trend queries run on every load for nothing. Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the re-seeded database: still reproduces. Fixed 2026-09-18: `components/teacher-analytics-dashboard.tsx` now renders the at-risk roster and the weekly trend from the overview it already fetched, so the At risk tile is no longer a dead end and neither read runs for nothing. Verified on the running app: GET /teacher/analytics as demo.teacher renders `At-risk students` (2 of 5 enrolled, pass line 50.0%, Demo Student Four below the line and Demo Student Five with no published work) and `Cohort trend` (15 teaching weeks, 8 released marks, chart SVG present).

findings.title: Code-tasks page renders 5000% and 10000% coverage

findings.title: Grading a rubric-less DESCRIPTIVE permanently blocks authoring its rubric
findings.evidence: After PUT /api/teacher/assessments/submissions published score 88, POST /api/teacher/rubrics returns 409 "Cannot edit a rubric after a grade has been published for this assessment"; the payload carries no locked flag so the editor stays editable until Save fails. findings.title: Grading editor's feedback-only save rewrites the submission status
findings.evidence: save() always sends score and an empty input validates to a null score, so a LATE submission became SUBMITTED with the LATE flag destroyed, and a DRAFT became SUBMITTED with submittedAt still NULL; the student's next save then returns 409. Caveat (re-verification 2026-09-17): the LATE and DRAFT submissions in the original observation were audit-created; the re-seeded database's 7 Submissions are all SUBMITTED with submittedAt set. The mechanism is unchanged; save() still posts a score on every save (components/teacher-submissions-manager.tsx:118-160). Fixed 2026-09-18: the editor no longer sends a score it was not given — `buildSubmissionSaveBody` in `lib/teacher-submissions-view.ts` omits an untouched score, so a feedback-only save cannot rewrite the status, while an emptied score field is still sent as an explicit null that deliberately un-grades. Verified by the new DB regression test `tests/submission-feedback-save-status.test.ts` (3 tests, passing against the test database): a LATE submission stays LATE with submittedAt intact and a DRAFT stays DRAFT with submittedAt null, and the explicit-clear case still un-grades.

findings.title: Students get a working submission box for CODE and GROUP_PROJECT that always fails
findings.evidence: components/student-assessments-view.tsx:449-516 branches only on QUIZ; submitting CODE or GROUP_PROJECT text returns 409 "Only written assessments support text submissions." and every row also carries a permanently disabled Detailed rubric soon button.

findings.title: Marks grid renders the cross-product of students x assessments across offerings and silently repairs bad input
findings.evidence: The payload unions students and assessments across offerings, so dsa.teacher sees 25 students x 14 assessments with 16 of 25 not enrolled and unwritable cells; the client clamps 9999 to maxMarks and ignores abc silently while the server refuses both. Re-verified 2026-09-17 against the re-seeded database: still reproduces.

findings.title: Code-task test cases can be created but never edited or deleted and re-scanning wipes the teacher's verdict
findings.evidence: PATCH and DELETE on test-cases work via the API but the only client call is POST; a similarity PATCH verdict FLAGGED is reset to PENDING by the next Scan cohort POST, and GET runs returns no sourceCode while GET similarity is 405. Caveat (re-verification 2026-09-17): the similarity verdict and the extra runs in the original observation were audit-created; the re-seeded database has only the 2 seeded PASSED runs and no similarity pairs. The mechanism is unchanged (only POST is wired for test cases; a re-scan rewrites pending verdicts). Fixed 2026-09-18: (1) a re-scan no longer discards a human verdict — `nextSimilarityVerdict` in `lib/code-eval/similarity.ts` keeps FLAGGED/CLEARED and only reclassifies new or PENDING pairs; (2) `TestCaseRowActions` in `components/teacher-code-task-actions.tsx` wires the existing PATCH and DELETE with per-row Edit and Delete dialogs, rendered from the page's test-case table. Verified: `tests/code-eval-similarity.test.ts` pins the verdict rule, and the extended `tests/code-eval-pipeline.test.ts` re-scans after a CLEARED verdict and sees it survive; both pass against the test database.

findings.title: Groups milestones are title-only and groups are disconnected from GROUP_PROJECT assessments
findings.evidence: The milestone API accepts description, weight and dueDate but the UI sends only groupId and title with no edit or delete; there is no peer-evaluation config surface, Group has no assessmentId (schema.prisma:890-906), and a student can be in two teams rendering Members placed 4 / 5 and Unassigned 2. The title-only milestone write path is unchanged (the UI sends only groupId and title). Partially fixed 2026-09-18, still open for the schema-dependent half. Done: milestone create now sends description, weight and due date (`lib/groups/milestone-form.ts`), each milestone has Edit and Delete actions backed by `deleteMilestoneForTeacher` and a new DELETE route handler, and the write paths refuse to place a student in two teams of one offering. Verified by `tests/groups-milestone-write-paths.test.ts` (5 tests passing against the test database: create fields, edit/clear, delete plus audit row, duplicate guard, reuse after archive). Not done, needs a decision: linking a Group to a GROUP_PROJECT assessment needs a new `Group.assessmentId` column, which is a schema change the brief forbids without approval, so it is reported here rather than migrated.
